commands: # In the cloud, per batch NNNN (LOGS/ holds the batch's downloaded logs and is deleted after the batch):
# The runner keeps noise-NNNN.json and response-NNNN.json as RUN/parts/ and packs the files of battery-obs/ (by name, no folders) into RUN/battery-obs/NNNN.tar:
# Locally, on the downloaded run folder RUN/ (manifests, parts/ and battery-obs/*.tar; no raw logs):
python -m log_validation.outputs merge -o noise-results.json --manifest RUN/manifest-noise.csv RUN/parts/noise-*.json
python -m log_validation.outputs merge -o response-results.json --manifest RUN/manifest-response.csv RUN/parts/response-*.json
for t in RUN/battery-obs/*.tar; do tar -xf "$t" -C battery-obs/; done
python -m log_validation.battery_fit --obs-dir battery-obs/ --manifest RUN/manifest-noise.csv --out-json battery-fit.json --out-md battery-fit.md

python -m log_validation.calibration_report --noise noise-results.json --battery battery-fit.json --response response-results.json --airframes airframes.json --run-info run-info.json --out-dir log_validation/calibration/2026-10-31 --forbid PRIVATE

parameters.batches: 9 batches of up to 20 GB; each batch folder holds the logs of both sets, so the noise and battery passes skip the logs only in the response set (133 in all) as logs without a manifest row, and the response pass skips the logs only in the noise and battery set (7,851 in all)
parameters.noise_and_battery_set: the logs that the rate-loop data screen kept as full-rate, reduced-rate or scenario logs
parameters.reproduce: the rate-loop data screen and the step that builds the manifests are not public; every entry of noise-results.json and response-results.json carries its Flight Review log ID and hashed vehicle ID, so the two manifests can be rebuilt from them, and log-ids/ lists the logs behind each pass's numbers
parameters.response_min_logged_rate_hz: 200 with 5 % tolerance, on the torque setpoint, rate and rate setpoint
parameters.response_set: the logs that the rate-loop data screen kept as full-rate; the response pass checks the logged rates again and refuses the logs not logged at the rate controller's rate (see Counts)
parameters.selection: quadrotor logs that the rate-loop data screen marked as real flights; duplicate uploads removed; at most 3 logs per vehicle (the smallest log IDs); vehicle IDs hashed; the passes found further simulation logs among them (SYS_HITL set, or a simulated sensor or board) and skipped them (see Counts)
parameters.source: public PX4 Flight Review logs, read from a mirror; raw logs never left the cloud runner
